title: Research: prove the sharp fifteen-line P112 two-six-flat cover floor
body:
## Summary

```diff
- distance/capacity estimate: at least 13 extra P112 lines after two six-flats
+ exact cover theorem: at least 15 extra lines, sharply attained
```

For every characteristic-zero root-code word, two binary six-dimensional label spaces leave at least fifteen live coordinates uncovered. Every one of the 120 root directions has exact maximum coverage 38, with literal attaining covers. The theorem also certifies a five-piece quotient basis of support capacity 54 for the historical `(6,5)` profile `2,3,4,6^8`.

Only `research/p112-two-six-flat-cover/` is added. The package includes the proof, two complete enumerators, source pins, mathematical receipt, controls and reproduction instructions. The profile's common-fourteen-cut span obligation remains open. No profile exclusion, full C5, supplier admission or new kappa is claimed.

## Evidence

- Before: the preferred five-piece capacity 54 fails the strict-below-53 certificate. After: its cover by two six-flats and fourteen lines proves quotient independence.
- All 788,035 linear six-spaces and 777,240 independently generated affine five-spaces yield the same 776,806 live masks. All 120 root directions pass 6,205,248 relevant pair comparisons and independent witness checks.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay and twelve behavioral groups pass. Optimized Python 3.13 reproduces the same receipt and controls from a read-only Git-free source export. Applicable Ruff diagnostics, warnings-as-errors compilation, source pins and all seventeen committed package/input byte comparisons pass.
- Two internal review rounds found and resolved an application-overlap error. PR3169 already excludes the initial calibration `2,3,4,5^2,6^5`; that profile is not counted as new coverage. Final caller arithmetic and common-set quotient reasoning passed fresh review.

Reproduce from the repository root:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-two-six-flat-cover
```

[Canonical finding and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-19000404). Credit DreamingOfClouds/PR3154 and retained E8/P112 lineage; Nick Petalas/PR3161/3162/3164/3177 for retained geometry; PR2985's older three-flat root-cover census and PR3169's coordinate exclusions. Exact source heads and hashes are in SOURCES.json. The Weyl-chamber theorem and original reduction remain written dependencies. Local validation is separate from hosted CI and independent human or proof-kernel review. Development and local checks used substantial automated assistance.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** package.

This isolated research package adds no selected-frontier or shared-verifier change. Its explicit replay hook reads one unchanged pinned data file.
